title: Characterization of Blank Input Positions
statement: Let $x$ be a finite word and let $d$ be a configuration with input-head position among the $|x|+2$ available positions, including the two boundary blanks. The input symbol read by $d$ is absent if and only if the head is at position $0$ or at position $|x|+1$.
